title: RouteVerify: Routing Interventions for Step-Level Verification in Mixture-of-Experts Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.25780v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Routing states in mixture-of-experts (MoE) models can distinguish correct from erroneous reasoning steps. If changing routing also changes a model's step-level verification judgment, it is tempting to conclude that the judgment follows what routing encodes. We test this inference with RouteVerify, a controlled intervention study that replaces selected internal activations from one solution trace with activations from another, while keeping the evaluated input unchanged. Across nine MoE checkpoints, we compare three intervention interfaces: router logits, MoE outputs, and post-MoE residual states. We vary the layers and token positions at which activations are replaced. We measure changes in a verification margin that quantifies the model's preference for INCORRECT over CORRECT. We also evaluate the same input with activations from correct versus erroneous steps to test whether the resulting judgment depends on the source step's correct

translated_title: RouteVerify：面向混合专家模型逐步验证的路由干预研究
translated_abstract: 混合专家模型中的路由状态能够区分正确与错误的推理步骤。如果改变路由也会改变模型的逐步验证判断，人们很容易得出结论：该判断遵循路由所编码的信息。我们通过 RouteVerify 对这一推断进行检验，这是一项受控干预研究，它将一个求解轨迹中被选定的内部激活替换为另一个轨迹中的激活，同时保持被评估的输入不变。在九个 MoE 检查点上，我们比较了三种干预接口：路由器 logits、MoE 输出以及 MoE 之后的残差状态。我们改变了激活被替换的层和词元位置，并测量验证边际（verification margin）的变化，该边际量化了模型对 INCORRECT 相对于 CORRECT 的偏好。我们还使用来自正确步骤与错误步骤的激活来评估相同的输入，以检验由此产生的判断是否取决于源步骤的正确性。
tldr: 该论文提出 RouteVerify 受控干预框架，通过在混合专家模型的九个检查点上替换路由器 logits、MoE 输出和残差状态等内部激活，系统检验路由状态与逐步验证判断之间的因果关系。
en_tdlr: RouteVerify is a controlled intervention study that replaces internal activations (router logits, MoE outputs, and post-MoE residual states) across nine MoE checkpoints to causally test whether step-level verification judgments follow what routing states encode.
